name: Arc A770 (Alchemist)
notes: Verified on this machine: PL 105-252 W (extended 315 via the bundled 2023 IGCL runtime), TL 60-90 C (extended 115), freq offset 0-300 MHz step 1, volt offset 0-0.234 V step 0.005, fan read-only (canControl=false), gpuLock supported, no VRAM offsets, no vfCurve, 32 Xe cores / 4096 shaders, driver 32.0.101.8861, mem clock ~2187 MHz. The mock keeps an editable-fan overlay (RID_MOCK_FAN_READONLY unset under --ui-verify) so the fan editor stays testable.
